post.title: Your $10 movie ticket? The theater keeps about $4
post.ig:
Your $10 movie ticket? The theater keeps about $4.
At Cinemark in 2025, 58.0% of US ticket sales went to film rent and advertising. Concession supplies were just 18.9% of US concession sales.
So $10 in tickets leaves $4.20 after film costs. $10 in snacks leaves $8.11 after supplies (before staff and rent).
Worldwide, concessions brought in $1.23 billion, 39% of revenue, and snack spending per visitor rose from $4.15 (2019) to $6.36 (2025).
Sources: Cinemark 2025 annual report (10-K) and earnings releases.
News and education, not financial advice.
